question: Will I definitely gain weight if I stop smoking? I'm really concerned about that.
answer: While some people may gain weight after quitting smoking due to changes in metabolism and appetite, this isn't inevitable. Maintaining a healthy diet and staying active can help manage your weight effectively during this transition.
